newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi airline to add 916 Ramadan, Eid flights.
newsitem.headline: Saudi airline to add 916 Ramadan, Eid flights.

text.p: Saudi Arabian Airlines Corp will be operating an extra 916 domestic and international flights during the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan and the Eid al-Fitr holidays which follow, its chief was quoted on Sunday as saying.
Saudi newspapers quoted Khaled Ben-Bakr as saying the airline would operate 601 extra domestic and 315 extra international flights during the season, which runs until mid-February.
Most of the additional international services would operate from Cairo, Turkey, Malaysia, Kuwait and the United Arab Emirates.
He said extra flights would provide 360,000 seats.
Ben-Bakr said the airline, which carries around 12.5 million passengers annually, expected to carry more than two million people in the current season.
